schema_version.description: Schema version this manifest is written against. Currently 1.

kind.description: `model` is a real, published model-zoo entry. `fixture` is a wiring/smoke entry that exists to exercise the zoo machinery, never a hardware claim -- scripts/validate_metadata.py's `_check_model_zoo_semantics` enforces that a `fixture` entry's `validated_soms` is empty and its `source` is `bundled` (never a bench claim, never an unverified upstream link). A `fixture` entry's `task` must be `smoke`; a `model` entry's `task` must never be `smoke` -- see this schema's own `allOf` of two independent `if`/`then` pairs (one gated on `kind: fixture`, one on `kind: model`), deliberately NOT a single `if`/`then`/`else` -- an `else` would also fire the task-not-smoke constraint when `kind` is missing or an invalid value, masking the real violation (missing/bad `kind`) behind an unrelated `task` complaint.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier; must match this manifest's own filename (`<id>.yaml`), enforced by scripts/validate_metadata.py's `_check_model_zoo_semantics` -- a `tan model zoo` lookup by id always resolves.

task.description: The edge-AI task this entry solves. Closed vocabulary (adding a task is a schema change, not free text) so `tan model zoo` can filter/group on it reliably. `smoke` is reserved for `kind: fixture` wiring entries (enforced by this schema's own `allOf` of two `kind`-gated `if`/`then` pairs) -- never a real task a customer selects.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this model does and why it's in the zoo.

license.description: SPDX id of the linked upstream model's own licence (its weights + graph), or of the bundled starter -- describes the WEIGHTS' terms, not the training dataset's. Validated against this permissive, closed allowlist (no `LicenseRef-*` escape): a copyleft (including AGPLv3 -- SPDX `AGPL-3.0-only` / `AGPL-3.0-or-later` -- the terms real Ultralytics YOLO checkpoints (e.g. yolo11n) ship under), non-commercial, or vendor-customer-only licence is rejected until explicitly admitted. Extending this allowlist is a deliberate human decision (legal review), not a metadata edit -- add the id here AND in metadata/model_zoo/README.md's allowlist rationale in the same change, mirroring metadata/libraries/README.md's own licence-allowlist process.

validated_soms.description: Bench-validated SKUs this exact model has been run on. Empty means NO SoM has been bench-validated yet -- `tan model zoo --sku <SKU>` matches NO entry with an empty list here, never treat empty as "unfiltered"/"works everywhere". A populated list is a hardware claim the entry author is responsible for; scripts/validate_metadata.py only checks that each listed SKU names a real, shipped SoM preset, not that the bench run actually happened.

compile.description: Per-backend compile configuration for NPU toolchains that need a per-model config + calibration the SDK cannot derive (DRP-AI, DEEPX). Keys are backend ids; a backend with no block here is recorded as a coverage skip ("no compile config") rather than guessed. Structurally identical to board.schema.json's models[].compile (tests/scripts/test_model_zoo_metadata.py's test_compile_matches_board_schema_definition is the drift guard) -- a zoo entry ships no compile INPUTS of its own; `tan model add` copies this block verbatim into the consuming project's board.yaml, where these paths are then resolved relative to THAT board.yaml, not to this manifest.

config.description: Path to the dxcom JSON config (per-model quantization/compile settings).

calibration.description: Path to the calibration dataset directory for post-training quantization.

input_shape.description: Model input geometry, NCHW. Either a comma string ("1,3,224,224") or a list of integers; passed to the DRP-AI TVM driver as `-s`.

input_name.description: ONNX graph input tensor name; passed to the DRP-AI TVM driver as `-i`.

images.description: Calibration image directory for post-training INT8 quantization (relative to this board.yaml); passed as `--images`.

product.description: DRP-AI TVM PRODUCT environment value. Defaults to V2N when omitted.

example_app.description: Repo-relative path to the example app under examples/ that demonstrates this model (same two-segment shape as template-catalog-v1.schema.json's `example`). scripts/validate_metadata.py's `_check_model_zoo_semantics` confirms the directory exists and carries a board.yaml, when examples/ is present in this checkout.
